observations: New browser_launch markers are fixed boolean observations. All false is unclassified, not evidence that no launch problem occurred. No category precedence invents a root cause.
Actual timer callback records wrapper_deadline_fired independently of error-string equality. Playwright15000ms and overall90000ms are unchanged.
STARTED diagnostic saved before launch; finally saves elapsed/state/markers before outer catch private log/cleanup. Existing parent process drainage remains authoritative.

The actual elapsed starts before the synchronous prelaunch save, so it includes that one save plus launch/race time. Treat it as instrumented launch-section duration, not pure Chrome internal startup time. This is a nonblocking measurement-scope note.
No success means original CI failure was fixed. Actual next launch may succeed without identifying previous cause.
limits: Static review only; marker-failure branches have not been exercised with actual Chrome failures.
Error.message is inspected transiently, but only booleans are output. Actual safe-output/key byte scan belongs to next real run.
Original CI chrome_launch/Error cause remains unknown; no raw original message has been reconstructed.
